notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you very much to all those who have played the game on release and pointed out the issues and problems that they have encountered! The following fixes have been made: 


 Fixed some typos and misspelling in various dialogues and descriptions
 Adjusted colliders in the tutorial fight to better reflect the border
 Fixed an issue where sound and music settings would not reflect saved values upon loading a save
 Fixed an issue where the light beam upgrade could not attack a certain enemy
 Fixed some issues with the Bestiary


Once again thank you all, I hope you have enjoyed this game (my very first, as some have rightly guessed!) and will continue to try and fix any issues that may come up!
